                          fix:  sudo apt-get install bubblewrap
fail  socat               socat is not on PATH; the Linux sandbox needs it
                          fix:  sudo apt-get install socat
fail  User namespaces     AppArmor restricts unprivileged user namespaces, so bubblewrap cannot isolate commands
                          fix:  sudo tee /etc/apparmor.d/bwrap > /dev/null <<'EOF'
                                abi <abi/4.0>,
                                include <tunables/global>

                                profile bwrap /usr/bin/bwrap flags=(unconfined) {
                                  userns,
                                  include if exists <local/bwrap>
                                }
                                EOF
                                sudo systemctl reload apparmor

                          fix:  export COLORTERM=truecolor (only when the terminal renders 24-bit color), or set ui.color = "256" in config.toml

                          fix:  sudo apt-get install xclip

                          fix:  edit /home/u/.claude/keybindings.json to use other keys, or set ui.alt_keys = false (and workspace.prefix) in config.toml

                          fix:  sudo usermod -aG docker "$USER" (then log out and back in)
